definitions.explanation: Official permission to do something, especially as granted by an authority; a document proving such permission.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧{免許|めんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{免許|めんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I need to renew my license.

examples.japanese: ⟦{免許|めんきょ}{証|しょう}→免許証：03160_menkyoshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {免許|めんきょ} refers to official licenses or permits, most commonly driving licenses.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧{免許|めんきょ} (driver's license)
- ⟦{免許|めんきょ}{証|しょう}→免許証：03160_menkyoshou⟧ (license card/document)
- {免許|めんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to get a license)
- {免許|めんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新：04765_koushin⟧ (to renew a license)
- {免許|めんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{消|け}す→取り消す：04224_torikesu⟧ (to have one's license revoked)
- {無|む}{免許|めんきょ} (without a license, unlicensed)

RELATED WORDS:
- {免許|めんきょ}{皆伝|かいでん} - mastery certification (in traditional arts)
